description: Canonical PDF Fixture Corpus Manifest for Antigravity PDF Reader

py-reorder-generator.notes: Deterministik canvas amaci (invariant=1) kaynak kod tarafindan desteklenmektedir, ancak paket surumleri repo lockfile ile sabitlenmemistir.

py-redaction-generator.notes: Yalnizca Python standart kutuphanesini kullanir. Sabit bayt ofsetleri ve tuzlari ile deterministiktir.

py-sanitization-generator.notes: Yalnizca Python standart kutuphanesini kullanir. Sabit FIXED_ID ile deterministiktir.

py-release-smoke-generator.notes: Pure Python standard library generator for release-smoke.pdf and large-page-dimensions.pdf fixtures.

pypdf-historical-method.notes: minimal.pdf uzerinden pypdf 6.10.0 ile uretilmistir; bayt-bayt determinizmi dogrulanmamistir.

py-heavy-page-generator.notes: Pure Python standard library generator for heavy-page.pdf (worker timeout and page quarantine fixture).

py-scanned-turkish-generator.notes: Turkish text is rasterized with Pillow and the system Arial TrueType font at 150 dpi; the PDF itself is written by hand with zlib (no font embedded). Same Pillow/FreeType/Arial versions give identical bytes; versions are not pinned by a repo lockfile.

rust-signature-generator.notes: TEST ONLY. Sabit anahtarlar (fixtures/signature/keys, OpenSSL 4.1.0 ile bir kez uretildi; EC skalerleri sabit etiketlerden), deterministik RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 / PSS (sabit tuz) / ECDSA RFC 6979; rand yok. src-tauri/tests/signature_fixture_generator.rs commit edilen baytlarin uretici ciktisiyla ayni oldugunu dogrular.

fixtures.source: Project-authored atomic I/O fixture with single Text annotation
Generated from minimal.pdf with pypdf 6.10.0 using RC4-128 user password
Project-authored 3-page fixture with distinct MediaBox dimensions (300x400, 400x500, 500x600)

fixtures.notes: Large page dimensions (7200x7200 pt / 100x100 in) minimal test fixture.
Four pages: index 0 and 3 light; index 1 nested Form XObjects (parse-heavy, multi-GB worker memory, manual baseline only); index 2 PostScript function shading (render-heavy, low memory).
Canonical release smoke fixture with multi-page, vector graphics, and self-contained Type 3 Turkish Unicode font.

Seven pages: 0-4 image-only scans of the same Turkish text (/Rotate 0, 90, 180, 270, and a CropBox offset); 5 has a Helvetica text layer (skipped as has_text); 6 is blank (skipped as no_image). has_text/has_unicode_text refer to page 5 and the raster text. Word boxes in display points are in scanned-turkish.words.json.
